label: training-gym-r56-complete
context:
Training Gym R56 completed! ALL 4 CLEAN ON FIRST TRY!

R56 RESULTS (all 10/10, all clean):
1. skip-list-001 (T8) - Skip list with random level generation. Header node, forward[] arrays, insert/search/delete.
2. interval-tree-001 (T8) - Interval tree for overlapping queries. Simple sorted-list approach with point and range queries.
3. avl-tree-001 (T8) - AVL tree with all 4 rotation cases. Insert, delete, balance. Height <= 3 for 6 nodes.
4. edit-distance-001 (T6) - Levenshtein distance with O(min(m,n)) space. Full 2D for path reconstruction.

DB: 271 exercises, 463 attempts, avg 9.89, 94.4% perfect. 211 passed.
22+ consecutive rounds all 10/10.

Key learning: AVL rotations — rotate_left(z): y=z.right, T2=y.left, y.left=z, z.right=T2. Update heights bottom-up. Balance factor = left_height - right_height. LR case: rotate left on left child first, then rotate right on node.
decisions: Skip list: header node at max_level, random_level with coin flips, update[] array tracks predecessors at each level
Interval tree: overlap condition is s < qend AND e > qstart. Point query: s <= point < e.
AVL: update height after every insert/delete, then balance. LR: left-rotate left child, right-rotate node. RL: reverse.
Edit distance backtrack: prefer match > replace > insert > delete. Position is in target string.
next_steps: Design R57 exercises. Try: B-tree, treap, radix sort, top-K with min-heap, or Dijkstra's with priority queue.
